# Guelph Furnace Repair

> Serving Guelph and the wider Wellington County region, Guelph Furnace Repair is a home comfort contractor covering furnace repair, air conditioner service, ductless installation, heat pumps, fireplaces, thermostats, and duct cleaning for Ontario homeowners.

Phone: (548) 901-0398  |  Email: contact@guelphfurnacerepair.ca  |  Website: https://guelphfurnacerepair.ca

Service areas: Guelph, Georgetown, Milton, Fergus, Elora, Acton, Rockwood
